limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
Only the four physically ordered sensor patterns are specified and tested. RTL holds the prior level on other patterns.
Behavior before the first synchronous reset is not specified and is not asserted by the testbench.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: Clocked water-level history and retained supplemental-valve direction. Supplemental flow opens for a rise into an intermediate level, as stated in the original problem. Extremes force maximum or zero flow. Reset synchronously sets all four outputs high.
verification: Independent integer level-history oracle covers every ordered level triplet, persistent unchanged levels, jumps, reversals, and repeated synchronous resets. Checks before and after clock edges verify absence of asynchronous input/reset effects.
static_review: Original ports and widths preserved; no extra latency or ports; nonblocking sequential assignments, fully assigned combinational level decoding, and no inferred combinational latches.
